Bug_Title: IP: A parameter is dead upon entry to a method but overwritten (IP_PARAMETER_IS_DEAD_BUT_OVERWRITTEN)
Bug_Details:
The initial value of this parameter is ignored, and the parameter
is overwritten here. This often indicates a mistaken belief that
the write to the parameter will be conveyed back to
the caller.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the parameter initialValue is initially assigned to the variable result. However, result is immediately overwritten with the value 42, ignoring the initial value passed to the method. This often leads to confusion as developers might expect the modified value to be returned to the caller.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with the argument 10. The method overwrites the initial value of the parameter and returns 42 instead of 10, causing the assertion to fail.
